characters.name: Rix Dalton
lines: Is it worth it?.. They won’t open the Playrix Shop anyway.
Rixcoins will burn again, and so will you. Think, cowboy.
They always called me reckless... But this time? You might be the reckless one!

characters.name: Shurix Smooth
lines: Psst, hey kid... Wanna buy some rixcoins? Imported stuff. Half price for you.
Still got time to grab some rixcoins from me… Sure, the Rix on the coin doesn’t have a tail, but who cares.
You’ve got good aim, haha. Go on, take the shot.

characters.name: C'ostin
lines: I decided to invest my rixcoins in a little growth experiment… You know, lilies, gladioluses…
Thinking of hitting on this one chick. Or maybe not… I pull a trigger more confidently than I flirt anyway.
This bar’s so messy I’m about to get a nervous twitch… Can we just end this already?

characters.name: Hackathoncius
lines: Ancient wisdom says: not everything that shines is a rixcoin.
You never know where you’ll find something, or where you’ll lose it… You should think about that!
The road is mastered by the one who walks it. In your case — the one who walks it to the end.

characters.name: Figmund Zeid
lines: Your obsession with rixcoins… would you say it started in childhood?
You chose to keep playing. What did you feel at that moment?
Let’s put your worries on the back burner… Oh, and that'll be $500.

characters.name: Jessica Horney
lines: Hey, handsome! Want me to show you my… rixcoins?
I see you like round things. Mmm… let’s go another round.
You like bringing girls to the finish line… Well then — final shot. And please, no misfires.

characters.name: Rixo Playrixcone
lines: You ask me for rixcoins, but you do it without respect.
You don’t offer friendship, you don’t call me Playrixcone… Very well, shoot.
The moment of truth!

characters.name: Sheriff Dukarix
lines: You’re under arrest for bribery with rixcoins. Unless we… settle it differently.
Not your rixcoins, huh? Someone planted them? Well then, let’s see.
You have the right to remain silent. Forever.

characters.name: Galina Duara
lines: Did you fill out form 15PNX? No? Then you’re not going anywhere.
Think you’ve got nerves of steel? Don’t make my quarterly reports laugh — I’ve kept this bar’s books for 30 years!
Don’t forget to sign in three places when you leave… this world.

characters.name: Obi-Tu Hellothere
lines: Wanderer… These aren't the rixcoins you’re looking for…
You were supposed to fight evil, not join it! But if that’s how you want it…
I am your father! …Okay, you’re not that gullible. Final shot.
